info.title: IntentGuard Protocol API
info.description: Owner-approved immutable agent spending. Explicit isolated X Layer testnet1952/mainnet196 payments; GenLayer Studionet61999 TESTNET review is always disclosed. V2 settlement and V4 reviewer preserve legacy testnet commitments. Only PAID confirms verified recipient delivery. Mainnet release preparation is not deployment evidence. Complete protocol, client guide and schemas are bundled with SDK/MCP/skill.

servers.description: Historical public testnet application; inspect current /config identity before authenticated use

SandboxVisitor.name: Authorization
SandboxVisitor.description: Sandbox <one-hour visitor capability>, held in memory and bound to the approved frontend origin and dedicated testnet card/key scope. No cookies, owner session or ig_ agent key; no arbitrary payments.

totalBudget.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

perPaymentLimit.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

periodBudget.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

items.description: Public HTTPS DNS origin; no credentials, path or query. The server rejects private/internal hosts and nonstandard ports.
Public HTTPS DNS origin; no credentials, path or query. The server rejects private/internal hosts and nonstandard ports.

Policy.description: Immutable version 1 policy. Server also requires expiry after start, per-payment limit <= total budget, unique merchant recipients and unique criterion IDs. Existing canonical policy hashes remain unchanged.

amount.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

url.description: Public HTTPS DNS evidence URL. Credentials, fragments, private/internal addresses and nonstandard ports are rejected; fetching verifies DNS and redirects independently.

PaymentInput.description: One invoice-backed purchase. Maximum canonical payload 14000 bytes. destinationChainId defaults to the card source chain; it must be immutable owner permission and currently verified capability. SDK/MCP additionally require unique evidence URLs.

SettlementLegacy.description: Preserved testnet-only permission JSON. Do not add version/environment fields to an existing commitment.

SettlementV2.description: New immutable asset/environment/destination permission. Canonical commitment sorts destinationChainIds ascending. Issuer registry entries are candidates; every selected route needs runtime release verification.

ReviewerProfileV4.description: V4 reviewer commits SHA-256 of this canonical profile in get_settlement_profile_hash. Mainnet payment chain196 remains distinct from Studionet review chain61999.

SpendingNetwork.description: Verified native-USDC route. An EVM chain ID differs from a CCTP domain; for example Base8453/Base Sepolia84532 both use domain6.

Config.description: Anonymous deployment identity and actual enabled capabilities. configured=false is not payment readiness. Legacy token/paymentSymbol are not an agent's deposit asset; use /me.card.token. Mainnet money is reviewed on explicitly disclosed Studionet testnet.

Health.description: Public health: 200 ready, 503 degraded. A database connection failure returns the normal Error envelope. No secrets, database URI or signing credentials are exposed.

Balances.description: funded is current physical token balance, not lifetime deposits. spent includes direct settlement and irreversible CCTP burns. available is physical balance minus reservations; lifetime and period permission may be smaller. periodSpent/periodReserved describe the current period, preserving each reservation's original period.

CardView.description: The agent's actual immutable token/settlement/reviewer. reviewerVersion may be absent for legacy cards; V2 settlement uses version4. Empty reviewerAddress means initialization has not produced a verified reviewer.

Review.description: Decision commitments and exact policy criteria. Every PASS needs supplied verified citations; every required criterion must PASS for APPROVE. Finalized receipt verification is mandatory.

amount.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

BridgeView.description: Persisted CCTP progress. PAID requires exact confirmed destination mint and source acknowledgement. paymentTxHash points to the destination for a bridge, and to the source for a direct payment. Never repeat an existing burn.

Admission.description: HTTP 202 confirms admission or the original idempotent operation. It does not confirm reservation, semantic approval or token delivery.

ActivationConfig.description: Exact owner-wallet factory arguments. Limits are uint64 atomic decimal strings. Verify the proposal, token and source chain before signing. API admission does not itself broadcast activation.

DraftInput.description: Complete mission+guidance <=16 KiB. Mainnet requires V2 settlement. Existing testnet omission/legacy permissions remain compatible. Settlement is separate from the legacy policy commitment.

Activation.description: CCTP_V2 identifies the legacy testnet factory; CCTP_V4 uses V2 USDC settlement; USDT0_LOCAL uses the X Layer mainnet-only factory. Missing kind preserves the legacy configured-token factory.

DraftOriginalInput.description: Original owner-supplied description and guidance; authenticated owner draft retrieval only. Settlement remains a separate field. Preserve it when recovering a failed proposal.

ReplacementInput.description: Owner acknowledgement creates a new empty vault proposal with the same policy. Budgets restart per vault; no funds, pending reservations, credentials or historical receipts move automatically.

ReplacementView.description: pendingCount is the full active count; pendingRequestIds is bounded to50. Existing CCTP burns must reconcile, not cancel. Rotate/revoke old keys and explicitly withdraw/deposit unreserved funds using the owner wallet.

AgentUsage.description: Actual admitted operations; idempotent HTTP retries do not inflate counts. fundsMoved sums PAID delivery, excluding pending burns. asOf is a timestamped snapshot, not a live solvency proof.

totalBudget.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

perPaymentLimit.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

periodBudget.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

amount.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

PublicTransaction.description: Public request record. List results may contain worker-cached review data; inspect the detail route's reasoningSource for independently verified final reasoning. A request record is not necessarily a transfer.

PublicTransactionDetail.description: Only genlayer-finalized-contract carries independently verified finalized contract reasoning. Skipped/failed/unavailable reviews are never presented as an invented or pending approval.

AgentCardSnapshot.description: Share URL uses the configured frontend origin. No agent key, owner session, wallet signature or merchant invoice is included.

BridgeProof.description: Worker-captured source burn/raw message/Iris/destination mint/amount-recipient-domain/nonce/balance/acknowledgement data. Optional data appears only after the phase was observed. Independently verify receipts and commitment digests; X Layer trusts the configured receipt attestor rather than a foreign-chain light client.

amount.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

DemoInvoice.description: Actual immutable testnet merchant invoice. buyer is the source vault; chainId/token are the delivery asset. A merchant-admin credential issues it; an agent cannot. Historical expired invoices are evidence, not new spend authorization.

SandboxScenarioView.description: Educational expected outcome; actual request status is produced by the normal worker and verified receipts, never hardcoded from this field.

SandboxLimits.description: Five preparations per visitor session, five submit attempts per visitor/minute, six new preparations per card/minute. Durable per-card lifetime ceiling defaults to30 and survives key rotation. At most one native-USDC atomic unit can settle per admitted permitted test.

SandboxEnabled.description: Dedicated native-USDC testnet card, local destination1952 only. Server-held agent key is never public. Actual finality/settlement may be delayed or fail.

SandboxDisabled.description: Readiness, pause, exhausted allowance or dependency failure. Existing requests remain inspectable with the same valid visitor capability or through public records.

SandboxSession.description: One-hour origin-bound visitor capability. expiresAt is Unix epoch milliseconds. Hold in private memory; do not persist/share or use as an agent/owner credential.

SandboxRequestInput.description: Only a fixed scenario. Arbitrary recipient, amount, evidence, asset, destination, card or owner fields are refused.

SandboxAdmission.description: 202 admits the original visitor operation. Save its ID and Idempotency-Key; expected outcome never replaces actual status.

amount.description: Positive exact decimal string with up to six fractional digits; maximum 18446744073709.551615 (uint64 atomic units). Never a JSON number.

url.description: Public HTTPS DNS evidence URL. Credentials, fragments, private/internal addresses and nonstandard ports are rejected; fetching verifies DNS and redirects independently.

SandboxRequestView.description: Actual normal-pipeline result scoped to the visitor session and dedicated local testnet card. Tracking does not require an active card or a successful live RPC balance check. Mainnet, another destination and bridge data are refused.
